AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Gisti manages the user's personal checklists: to-do lists, shopping lists, packing lists and routines. Each checklist has a name and ordered items that can be marked done; items can carry a one-time reminder. Operational patterns: - When the target checklist is unclear, call listChecklists first and pass the checklist's id as checklistId where the function accepts it; names match by substring, so a short name can match several checklists. - If a call reports that several checklists match, ask the user which one and repeat the call with its checklistId. renameChecklist and the destination of moveItem take a name only: use a longer, unique name, otherwise that change has to be made in the app. - Use addItems once with all items rather than one call per item. - Call readChecklist before completeItem or moveItem when the exact item text is unknown. - Use findItems to locate an item when the checklist is unknown. Constraints: - Times are in the device's local time zone; reminders must be in the future. Repeating reminders cannot be set or changed through these functions. - The free plan limits how many checklists the user can create; a limit error means the user can upgrade in the app. - The user's Inbox list is not listed by listChecklists. Deleting items or checklists is not available through these functions.
